title: Kononenkogroup statement
description: A manifesto band: a huge two-line grotesk heading centred on white (9vw), two small grey notes placed on a 15-column grid beneath it, then a full-bleed photo (2.4:1 on desktop, 3:2 on phones). The heading lines and notes rise from their masks as they enter; the photo travels slowly through its frame.
notes: CSS only: reveals and parallax are scroll-driven and simply don't happen without support
name: kononenkogroup-statement
